chars.ASMAA: ASMAA: a teenage Moroccan girl wearing a mint-green oversized hoodie with a white star on the chest, light grey joggers, white sneakers.
chars.DAD: DAD: a Moroccan father in his fifties wearing a dark brown cardigan over a white shirt, beige trousers, black rectangular glasses, small grey moustache.
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a teenage Moroccan girl, Asmaa's best friend, wearing a mustard-yellow puffer vest over a striped navy-and-white long-sleeve top, blue jeans.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night, a cosy Moroccan living room with a traditional salon sofa (sedari) and patterned cushions, warm lamp light. DAD sits on the sofa holding a smartphone, frowning, and firmly beckons with his hand; ASMAA stands in the doorway frozen, guilty and scared, clutching her own phone behind her back. Comic tension.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan salon at night. ASMAA sits stiffly on the edge of the sofa next to DAD, sweating nervously with a tiny forced smile; DAD looks at her very seriously, about to speak. Awkward comic mood.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan salon. DAD raises one finger and lectures with a strict, preachy face; ASMAA shrinks into the cushions, eyes wide, nodding nervously. Comic family scene.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan salon. DAD turns his phone screen toward ASMAA (screen shows only a blurry glow), shaking his head disapprovingly; ASMAA stares at the phone in panic, a drop of sweat on her head.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan salon. DAD keeps scrolling on his phone with a stern face; ASMAA sits beside him with her hands pressed together in a silent prayer, eyes squeezed shut, terrified. Comic suspense.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Daytime, a Moroccan schoolyard with white walls and a green door. ASMAA grabs SALMA by the arm and whispers urgently, panicked; SALMA listens with a shocked open mouth.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan schoolyard, sitting on a low wall. SALMA confidently points at ASMAA's phone giving advice like an expert; ASMAA holds the phone and nods with relief.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Night, a girl's small bedroom in a Moroccan apartment, posters on the wall. ASMAA sits on her bed lit only by her phone screen glow, a mysterious sly half-smile, the door slightly open behind her with a dark hallway. Ominous suspense.
